note: No presentation. The host answers about a room only to a party the room itself has authorized to read it; a host-side account or session is never the authority in this family.
Asking for another member's figures. A member reads the room's totals and their own; per-member usage is the room owner's read (rooms/usage), and an unknown member is refused rather than ignored.
A response with no room totals. `usage.room` is what a member checks a file against before uploading it; a response without it cannot answer the question the task exists for.
A room-wide file size ceiling above 1 GiB, the transfer ceiling. No limit may promise more than the chunked transfer can carry.
